 Coram:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANISH DAYAL  ORDER % 22.03.2023 CRL.M.A. 7554/2023 (Exemption)
1. Exemption is allowed subject to all just exceptions.
1. This application/petition has been filed seeking anticipatory bail for the petitioner in FIR No.198/2022 registered under Sections 420/467/120B/34 IPC at PS Daryaganj, New Delhi.

2. At the very outset, the Ld. APP has stated that the petitioner has not disclosed the previous order of this Court dated 18.10.2022 whereby anticipatory bail application of the petitioner was dismissed by a Coordinate Bench and also it was not disclosed before the Sessions Court, as noted in the order dated 01.03.2023.
The learned counsel for the petitioner, however, states that they have disclosed the same in para 5 of their petition but for some clerical reasons, the said order could not appended.

3. Notwithstanding the same, the learned counsel for the petitioner states that they are ready to pay an amount of Rs.9 Lakhs to the complainant, which is inclusive of Rs.6.75 Lakhs that the complainant had paid to the co-accused.

They are presenting a DD bearing No.510888 dated 01.02.2023 for Rs.3,00,000/-, drawn on Bank of Baroda, Shahabad Gate, Rampur-244901, to the complainant, who is present in the Court accompanied by her counsel, as an advance amount towards the settlement.

The complainant has duly received the same and acknowledged it but it is noted that there is a spelling mistake in the said Demand Draft and if the Demand Draft is not honoured by her bank, the petitioner undertakes to rectify the same and issue a fresh Demand Draft immediately upon being put to such notice.
4. The balance amount of Rs.6 Lakhs as per the settlement will be paid to the complainant within one month from today.

Subject to these conditions being satisfied, the petitioner be not arrested till Mrs. Nishat Fatima vs The State on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/62246662/
1 the next date of hearing.
